# license-detector

> Detect open-source licenses from raw file text using normalized fingerprint matching against a built-in corpus of 12 common licenses.

This library reads plain license text (a LICENSE file's contents, a header comment, whatever you
hand it) and scores it against distinctive-phrase fingerprints for 12 common SPDX licenses (MIT,
Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3-Clause, ISC, GPL-2/3, LGPL-3.0, MPL-2.0, Unlicense, CC0-1.0, WTFPL). Matching is
normalized (lowercased, copyright lines stripped, whitespace collapsed) and phrase-based, so it
survives changed copyright holders/years but is sensitive to reworded license text. It also includes
a small SPDX expression parser for AND/OR/WITH syntax. This is a text heuristic, not legal advice —
always confirm licensing decisions with a human or counsel.

## API

- `detectLicense(text: string, options?: DetectOptions): DetectionResult[]`
- `detectLicenseBatch(files: BatchInput[], options?: DetectOptions): BatchResult[]`
- `normalize(text: string): string`
- `listKnownLicenses(): string[]`
- `parseSpdxExpression(expression: string): SpdxNode`
- `collectLicenseIds(node: SpdxNode): string[]`
- Types: `DetectionResult`, `DetectOptions`, `BatchInput`, `BatchResult`, `SpdxNode`

## Install

```
npm install license-detector
```

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
